title: Scarface
tagline: Big ambition. Bigger plate of croquetas.
about: A Cuban refugee claws his way to the top of Miami's underworld.
cue: Serve the mains when Tony first walks into the Babylon Club.

A Cuban supper in MiamiScarfaceBig night out. Save me the last croqueta.Every recipe serves 4.
    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersFreedom Town croquetasSerrano ham béchamel, crumbed and fried golden. Lime.Camp food, before the green card.How to make it60g butter70g plain flour500ml warm milk100g serrano ham, finely chopped1 pinch ground nutmeg2 eggs, beaten100g fine breadcrumbs500ml neutral oil, for frying1 lime, cut in wedgesMelt the butter, stir in the flour for 2 minutes, then whisk in the warm milk and cook until very thick.Stir in the ham and nutmeg, spread on a tray, cover and chill overnight.Roll into 16 logs, dip in egg and then breadcrumbs.Fry in the oil at 180°C in batches until golden and serve with lime.TostonesGreen plantain fried twice, smashed flat, garlic and lime mojo.A crisp side from the Little Havana counter.How to make it3 green plantains500ml neutral oil, for frying3 garlic cloves, crushed2 limes, juiced60ml olive oilflaky salt, to tastePeel the plantains and cut into 3cm chunks.Fry at 160°C for 4 minutes until soft.Smash flat with a heavy glass and fry again at 190°C until crisp.Mix the garlic, lime juice and olive oil, spoon over and finish with flaky salt.MainsRopa viejaFlank steak shredded into peppers, tomato, olives. Rice, beans.Supper before the floor show.How to make it1kg flank steak2 bay leaves2 onions2 capsicums, sliced3 garlic cloves, sliced2 tbsp olive oil2 tsp ground cumin1 tsp dried oregano400g crushed tomatoes80g green olives300g long grain rice800g tinned black beans (2 tins)Simmer the steak with the bay leaves and half an onion in water until tender. Shred it and keep 250ml of the broth.Fry the sliced onion, capsicums and garlic in olive oil until soft.Add the cumin, oregano, tomatoes, olives, beef and broth and simmer.Cook the rice and warm the black beans, and serve alongside.SweetsMagic City pastelitosPuff pastry, guava paste and cream cheese, sugar crust.Word to the wise: never skip the pastelitos.How to make it2 sheets of puff pastry120g guava paste100g cream cheese1 egg, beaten1 tbsp sugarCut the pastry sheets into 8 squares in all.Put a slice of guava paste and a teaspoon of cream cheese in the middle of 4 squares.Cover with the other squares, press the edges with a fork, brush with egg and sprinkle with sugar.Bake at 200°C until puffed.DrinksBabylon Club mojitoWhite rum, lime and mint over crushed ice, soda on top.Ask for a booth. Mind your manners.How to make it60g caster sugar60ml hot water32 mint leaves100ml lime juice (about 4 limes)200ml white rum2 cups of crushed ice200ml soda waterDissolve the sugar in the hot water and cool to make syrup.In each tall glass, gently muddle mint with some syrup and lime juice.Add rum, fill with crushed ice, top with soda and stir.
